verdict.rationale: Docs mention Teams Export APIs for retention/compliance and note that deleted messages remain accessible via export for 21 days, which touches on data retention/deletion but is an admin/compliance capability rather than direct end-user control, and no evidence describes an AI-native user (e.g., Copilot chat data) being able to set or manage their own retention/deletion policies. Missing for 10: user-facing retention/deletion controls for AI/Copilot interactions, self-service data deletion tools, and any documentation of granular retention policy configuration by end users.
